title: V11 Autonomy Audit Trail Line
description: Schema for ONE line of ~/.agent-metrics/autonomy-audit.jsonl. Appended by track-autonomy hook on every PostToolUse Write/Edit/Bash event. V11.4 enriched with task_id/agent_id/diff_summary/diff_hash. V11.20 adds caller_kind to distinguish orchestrator runtime actions from subagent runtime actions in agent-scorecard. Legacy entries (pre-V11.4) lack the enrichment fields; pre-V11.20 entries lack caller_kind. All additions are ADDITIVE — consumers tolerate absence and default caller_kind to 'unknown'.

action.description: Write | Edit | Bash | TaskCreate | TaskUpdate (PostToolUse tool_name)

file.description: Absolute file path for Write/Edit; command string for Bash

approval_method.description: How the action was authorized: explicit, trusted_low, trusted_medium, autonomy_a4, autonomy_a5, autonomy_grant

grant_matched.description: Name of the autonomy grant that matched, if any

agent_id.description: V11.4: active_agent_id from task-state (set by sync-tasks from TaskUpdate owner)

diff_summary.description: V11.4: git diff --stat one-liner for Write/Edit

diff_hash.description: V11.4: 8-char hash of the diff content for cross-event correlation

caller_kind.description: V11.20: was this event triggered by the main orchestrator session or a spawned subagent? Resolved by v11_caller_kind. Rollback: V11_CALLER_KIND=off keeps field unset (legacy).

executor_kind.description: V11.21: For TaskUpdate events on review tasks, identifies the agent's review role. self = implementing agent self-reviewing its own work (Layer A). adversarial = adversarial-lite-reviewer reviewing a sibling parent (Layer B). Orthogonal to caller_kind: both layers can be run from orchestrator OR subagent sessions. Optional — absent on non-review events and pre-V11.21 entries. Rollback: V11_EXECUTOR_KIND=off keeps field unset.
